verdict.rationale: For a GPU, the documented public programming interface is the CUDA Toolkit. The evidence shows it ships a runtime library, GPU-accelerated libraries and compiler tools, plus Python and C++ tile-kernel APIs. Further documented interfaces are the Video Codec SDK (NVENC/NVDEC), the RTX Neural Shaders SDK, and RAPIDS APIs that mirror Pandas and Scikit-learn. A community user reports that many main libraries lack support for this card's SM120 architecture, which limits how fully the API stack serves it. Missing for 10: direct API-reference documentation in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the card through these APIs, full library support for SM120, and a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404 and the CUDA docs .md page returned 404).
